lines.differs: Harsher on the vendor than Rohan Iyer: AtliQ pays within 60 days or after client payment instead of within 30 days.
Harsher on the vendor than PayTrack Technologies: AtliQ pays within 60 days or client payment rather than 30 days.
Harsher on the vendor than Sunrise Foods: AtliQ pays within 60 days or client payment rather than 30 days.
Fairer to the vendor than Brightwater Insurance Inc: penalty is 1% of Work Order value per day rather than total contract value.
Harsher on the vendor than Acme Retail Group: penalty is 1% per day uncapped, compared to 0.5% per week capped at 5%.
Harsher on the vendor than Al Noor Hospitality Group: penalty applies 1% per day on Work Order value for any delayed task.
Harsher on the vendor than Rohan Iyer: AtliQ owns all work product and pre-existing materials instead of receiving a non-exclusive licence.
Harsher on the vendor than Acme Retail Group: pre-existing materials vest in AtliQ upon creation rather than being retained with a licence.
Harsher on the vendor than PayTrack Technologies: pre-existing materials vest in AtliQ on creation instead of remaining with vendor under licence.
Harsher on the vendor than Rohan Iyer: confidentiality obligation is unilateral and lacks exceptions for public or already known information.
Same as Brightwater Insurance Inc: vendor must keep all client and company information confidential indefinitely.
Harsher on the vendor than PayTrack Technologies: confidentiality is indefinite for all information rather than 5 years for non-client data.
Harsher on the vendor than PayTrack Technologies: indemnity is unilateral and broad, while AtliQ's liability is capped at one month.
Harsher on the vendor than Acme Retail Group: indemnity is unilateral covering any act or omission, and vendor liability is uncapped.
Harsher on the vendor than Brightwater Insurance Inc: vendor liability is uncapped rather than capped at 150% of contract value.
Harsher on the vendor than Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: restriction lasts 24 months post-term instead of 12 months.
Fairer to the vendor than Al Noor Hospitality Group: restricts only serving AtliQ clients rather than any hospitality business in the GCC.
Harsher on the vendor than CloudSpan Technologies: restriction continues for 24 months post-termination rather than applying only during the term.
